protocol: Frozen single-configuration development baseline; 48 chart tasks and 2 technical boundaries; no blind holdout, no automatic adoption.
evidence_kind: Real model/tool/renderer runs plus independent local agent audits; not human-adjudicated gold.

telemetry.attempt_count_note: Includes client-side cancelled model calls; does not count unobserved downstream retry internals.

audit_definitions.chart_suitable: A suitable proposed chart family for the brief, not proof of optimality or successful rendering.
audit_definitions.first_render_visual: First render attempt, including a no-image technical failure.
audit_definitions.final_render_visual: Last retained PNG, not proof it was published or linked in final reply.
audit_definitions.final_delivery: Final-response PNG link; false is expected for the 2 no-chart boundary tasks.
audit_definitions.task_correct: Agent judgment of intent, semantics, factual final claims and useful delivery. A complete faithful Markdown table can satisfy a table-permitted task without meeting the separate PNG-link contract.
audit_definitions.reviewer_false_rejection: At least one false or overstrict error-level finding within the case; not per-call accuracy.
audit_definitions.unnecessary_repair: Includes a blocked extra repair attempt; null means not established.

limitations: This development bank is reused, not held out.
The broad supplemental briefs often allow a table and do not establish the optimal chart family.
Raw numeric and reviewer-pass gates have known false failures; raw scores were not rewritten.
Native PNG inspection does not establish provider-resized image perception or UI viewport readability.
Uncertainty and no-image outcomes are retained rather than counted as correct.
Runtime optimization remains blocked; independent audit prose is not yet a validated executable quality metric.
